name: nsfocus-waf-v6-0-7
description: OctoBus package for NSFOCUS Web Application Firewall L4 ACL block, blocked IP query, and unblock APIs calibrated against the V6.0.7.3 REST document.

nsfocus.waf.v6.NSFOCUSWAFService/BlockIP.name: block-ip
nsfocus.waf.v6.NSFOCUSWAFService/BlockIP.description: 创建网络层访问控制（L4 ACL）策略封禁源 IP。

nsfocus.waf.v6.NSFOCUSWAFService/ListBlo.name: list-blocked-ips
nsfocus.waf.v6.NSFOCUSWAFService/ListBlo.description: 查询网络层访问控制策略，可按 IP 过滤。

nsfocus.waf.v6.NSFOCUSWAFService/Unblock.name: unblock-ip
nsfocus.waf.v6.NSFOCUSWAFService/Unblock.description: 删除网络层访问控制策略以解封 IP。
